privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_p: At OpenTools, your privacy is our top priority. We built this platform on the principle that your files belong entirely to you. We never view, copy, or sell your data.
privacy.s2_li1_text: The files you upload are processed only for the conversion or compression you request.
privacy.s2_li2_text: All uploaded and generated files are automatically and permanently deleted from our servers within 5 minutes at most after processing is complete.
privacy.s2_li3_text: We do not keep backup copies of your files. Once deleted, the files cannot be recovered by anyone.
privacy.s3_li1: The contents of your document, image, audio, or video files.
privacy.s3_li2: Personally identifiable information (name, email, etc.), since we do not require account registration.
privacy.s4_p: All data transfers between your device and our servers are encrypted using industry-standard security protocols (HTTPS/TLS). We ensure your connection is protected from third parties.
privacy.s5_p: Transparency is the key to trust. The source code of OpenTools is open to the public. Anyone can audit, review, and verify that we keep our privacy promises. You can view our source code in our GitHub repository.
